title: Inpatient Stays, Equipment Pickup and Travel: Durable Medical Equipment Rentals Desk Reference
content:
Durable Medical Equipment Rentals - class terms for an inpatient stay, the supplier's pickup of returned equipment, and a temporary supplier while the patient travels.

| Payment class | Rental months not paid while the patient is an inpatient | Months not paid during an inpatient stay count toward the cap | Business days within which the supplier picks up returned equipment | A temporary supplier may furnish the item while the patient travels |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | Yes | No | 5 | No |
| Capped Rental Equipment | Yes | No | 5 | No |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | Yes | No | 5 | No |
| Power Mobility Device | Yes | No | 5 | No |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | Yes | No | 5 | Yes |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | Yes | No | 5 | Yes |
| Customized Equipment | Yes | No | 5 | No |

**Inpatient stays.** In all seven classes rental months are not paid while the patient is an inpatient, and the months not paid during the stay do not count toward the cap.

**Pickup.** In all seven classes the supplier picks up returned equipment within 5 business days.

**Travel.** A temporary supplier may furnish the item while the patient travels only for Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment and Frequently Serviced Equipment; in the other five classes the schedule does not allow a temporary supplier while traveling.
